descriptions.text: Casket in the Sky. Party Planner. Tilt Rotor Stealth Light Bomber. Vehicle. This vehicle is classed as tier three Armor.

recap.text: Louis uses a celestial box to get an Airship Portal and a silver tilt-rotor he names Party Planner. A gravity-magic dragon circling the Reaver castle casts a spell and rips Party Planner in half down the middle. Bombs drop without arming, and two door gunners from a clinic are believed dead. Louis uses feather fall to drop toward the Reaver castle.

beats.headline: The reward for having survived being condemned
beats.text: It comes out of the celestial box Louis earned for outliving a goddess's mark for death on the floor before. Two items: a tier III guild upgrade called an Airship Portal, and the ship itself, a silver tilt-rotor he names Party Planner, the name Firas once suggested for another vehicle.
beats.gist: Louis takes an Airship Portal and a silver tilt-rotor named Party Planner from a celestial box.

beats.headline: Ripped down the middle
beats.text: Party Planner, the airship, has been destroyed. On its next sortie, the gravity-magic dragon circling the Reaver castle came straight at it, and General Louis hit it with missiles, which only made it angry. It cast a spell and ripped the ship in half down the middle. The bombs dropped out before they were armed and did not go off. The two replacement door gunners, borrowed from a clinic, are believed dead. Louis went out by feather fall, dropping straight toward the Reaver castle, which he means to hit by himself.
beats.gist: A gravity-magic dragon rips the airship Party Planner in half, killing two clinic door gunners.
